Extract fitted values from a RiskMap model

Source: R/auxiliary.R
fitted.RiskMap.Rd

Extract fitted values from a RiskMap model

Usage

# S3 method for class 'RiskMap'
fitted(object, type = c("response", "link"), ...)

Arguments

object

A fitted RiskMap object.

type

Whether to return fitted values on the response or link scale.

...

Additional arguments, currently unused.

Value

A numeric vector, or NULL when final conditional sampling was skipped for a non-Gaussian model.

Examples

data(italy_sim)

fit <- glgpm(
  formula = y ~ gp(),
  data = italy_sim[1:100,],
  family = "gaussian",
  return_samples = TRUE,
  messages = FALSE
)

fitted(fit)
